conclusion.verified_title: GraphMoRE: Mitigating Topological Heterogeneity via Mixture of Riemannian Experts

selected_passages.scope: Main method sections4.1-4.5, equations1-11 and Algorithm1; scoped main text, not every preliminary/page passage
native optimizer, grid and curvature recipe

exact_read_scope.scope_note: Method-specific read, not a full-paper/every-page read. Official host failed, exact-title arXiv fallback used.

conclusion.saved_takeaway: Experts start with different curvatures{-3,-1,0,1,3}; local topology encoding routes to manifold experts through a distortion objective plus task loss. Pair-specific expert alignment defines the downstream distance. Costs include all experts, subgraph sampling and the gate.
conclusion.relationship_to_GNNM_and_extension: Topology-aware expert initialization and adaptive local expert fusion are published. Its topological heterogeneity is not evidence of heterogeneous node/relation processing.
conclusion.attributed_prior_vs_open_gap: Attribute varied curvature initialization and distortion-guided topology gating. The candidate is a one-time Euclidean private-factor expansion tied to supervised class residuals; no manifold diversity/gate contribution is claimed.
conclusion.decisive_next_step: Treat geometry diversity as a close design prior; include supervised predictive complementarity, because geometric/structural diversity alone does not certify different useful class decisions.

conclusion.verified_title: BernNet: Learning Arbitrary Graph Spectral Filters via Bernstein Approximation

selected_passages.scope: experimental details page12 and beginning page13

exact_read_scope.scope_note: Full spectral basis/objective method read; no unrelated proof audit.

conclusion.saved_takeaway: Degree-K Bernstein graph operators binom(K,k)(2I-L)^(K-k)L^k/2^K give controlled spectral bands and sum to I. Native model learns filter coefficients after an MLP.
conclusion.relationship_to_GNNM_and_extension: The four degree3 graph-band operators used in the candidate are directly borrowed from BernNet. Graph frequency partition alone does not guarantee useful expert diversity.
conclusion.attributed_prior_vs_open_gap: Attribute basis, spectral band interpretation and all-pass identity. Candidate uses filtered supervised logit residuals to seed fast-factor tangents rather than replacing graph convolution with learned BernNet filters.
conclusion.decisive_next_step: Use exact normalized symmetric topology and define isolate/self-loop convention; test graph alignment against a node-permuted-topology control.

record.verified_title: Mixture of Link Predictors on Graphs
record.exact_read_scope: §4 Eqs1–3, Algorithm1; §5.1; AppendixA.2 and G/H/J/K scoped paragraphs; READ_SCOPES.json exact IDs
record.saved_takeaway: Link-MoE uses pair-specific softmax expert weights from separate MLP branches over structural heuristics and endpoint Hadamard features, then sigmoid of the weighted expert-score sum. Experts train independently and their inferred scores train a second-stage gate. Uniform/global ensembles and LP stacking are explicit controls.
record.protocol_limit: On collab the gate trains on80% of official validation and selects on20%, requiring explicit supervision matching. Full expert fit/inference remains costly.
record.relationship: Direct structure-conditioned expert-combination prior; M4 homogeneous parameter sharing is a practical architecture substitution, not a new routing or graph-learning principle.
